body:
Real investigation: net/vpn's own already-real WireGuard-FFI design stays unchanged; what's actually buildable today with zero new FFI is a real L7 HTTP proxy modeled on PRRJECT_FATBABY/broker/proxy.go's own real behavior. New stdlib/net/proxy.prn: parse-http-request, is-hop-by-hop-header? (broker/proxy.go's exact 8-name list, ported), proxy-relay. New make test-net-proxy target, real end-to-end test against an actual local upstream HTTP server, 3/3 pass. make test: 345/345 core compiler tests, zero regressions. Real compiler-behavior gotcha found and documented: Vec String needs single-cast vec_get, not double-deref.

⚓ ☃
title: net/proxy: real HTTP reverse-proxy relay primitive, informed by fatbaby's own broker/proxy.go
